latest_release.body:
**Windows:** download **AutoSwarm-Desk-Setup.exe** and run it. It installs for the current user, includes Python, and updates itself.
Without installing: unzip **AutoSwarm-Desk-0.1.0-win-x64.zip** and run `AutoSwarm Desk.exe`.

**macOS:** download **AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-arm64.dmg** for Apple silicon (M1 and later) or **AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-x64.dmg** for Intel Macs, open it and drag AutoSwarm Desk to Applications. Python is included. Desk is not signed with an Apple Developer ID: the first time, choose Done, then System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway (under Security). A Mac copy does not update itself; the sidebar links to a new version.
Without a disk image: unzip **AutoSwarm-Desk-0.1.0-mac-arm64.zip** or **-mac-x64.zip**.

**Windows：** 下载 **AutoSwarm-Desk-Setup.exe** 并运行。安装到当前用户，自带 Python，会自动更新。
免安装：解压 **AutoSwarm-Desk-0.1.0-win-x64.zip**，运行 `AutoSwarm Desk.exe`。

**macOS：** Apple 芯片（M1 及以后）下载 **AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-arm64.dmg**，Intel 芯片下载 **AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-x64.dmg**，打开后把 AutoSwarm Desk 拖进「应用程序」。自带 Python。Desk 没有 Apple 开发者证书签名：第一次打开时点「完成」，再到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」，在「安全性」下点「仍要打开」。Mac 版不会自动更新，有新版本时侧栏会给出下载链接。
不用磁盘映像：解压 **AutoSwarm-Desk-0.1.0-mac-arm64.zip** 或 **-mac-x64.zip**。

AutoSwarm-Desk-Update.exe, its .blockmap and latest.yml are read by Desk's automatic update; they are not needed for a manual download.

detail.readme:
AutoSwarm: Unify All Your Agents. Break Context Barriers.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-arXiv-B31B1B?style=flat&logo=arxiv&logoColor=white)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33048) [![Feishu](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feishu-Group-E9DBFC?style=flat)](./COMMUNICATION.md) [![WeChat](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeChat-Group-C5EAB4?style=flat&logo=wechat&logoColor=white)](./COMMUNICATION.md) [![Download AutoSwarm for Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-AutoSwarm%20Desk%20for%20Windows-4176E6?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-Setup.exe) [![Download AutoSwarm for Mac (Apple silicon)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-macOS%20%28Apple%20silicon%29-4176E6?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-arm64.dmg) [![Download AutoSwarm for Mac (Intel)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-macOS%20%28Intel%29-4176E6?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-x64.dmg)
**New:** **AutoSwarm Desktop Released** — All Your Agents in One Private Workspace One window to coordinate agents, share context, review approvals, and track progress. Watch all your agents work together for you. [What AutoSwarm does](desktop/README.md)

## Why AutoSwarm? **No single agent can do everything. You don’t need another agent—you need all your agents working as one.** Different agents come with different: - 🛠️ **Capabilities** — coding, research, browsing, office work, writing, computer use, and social networking; - 🧠 **Context and Memory** — each agent maintains its own context, with little or no sharing across agents; - ⚙️ **Tools and Workflows** — each agent follows its own interaction patterns and execution process; - 🌐 **Data and Application Ecosystems** — agents are connected to different platforms, services, files, and data. Today, you are forced to switch interfaces, repeat information, coordinate subtasks, and manually combine results. **AutoSwarm turns fragmented agents into one coordinated team.** Give AutoSwarm a task once. It unifies all your agents into one coordinated team: - **Selects the right agents** based on their capabilities; - **Shares context and memory** across agents; - **Connects complementary tools** and workflows; - **Bridges data** and application ecosystems; - **Runs tasks in parallel** for faster execution; - **Coordinates agent collaboration** and keeps everyone aligned; - **Verifies and synthesizes results** into one coherent answer.
## 🤖 Agents AutoSwarm Can Call


Codex


Claude Code


OpenCode


Cursor


GitHub Copilot CLI


Meta Muse Code


CodeBuddy


Hermes


Nanobot


DeepSeek Harness


Grok Build


Kimi Code
AutoSwarm works across Windows, macOS, and Linux. Use AutoSwarm through: - **Desktop apps** — [AutoSwarm Desk for Windows and macOS (private assistant and live collaboration)](desktop/README.md) - **Command-line interfaces (CLI)** - **IDE extensions** - **Skill-enabled agent environments** The main host needs Skill support and local command execution. Collaborators need compatible local CLIs; your assistant can help connect missing ones. ## 🖥️ AutoSwarm Desk App

## 🚀 Easy to use One Lightweight Plug-in. Any Agent as Your Entry Point. All Your Agent at Work. ### How to Use AutoSwarm Give AutoSwarm to any agent you already use and ask: ```bash Install or update AutoSwarm for this agent. Reuse my existing configuration and verify which locally installed agents are available. ``` Your assistant will report which collaborators are ready. To add another, tell it the agent's name; it will handle setup and verification. Then start any task with: ```bash Use AutoSwarm to read these 100 documents and summarize the key approaches and disagreements. ``` AutoSwarm selects, connects, and coordinates the right agents for every task. ## 🤖 AutoSwarm in Action
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89a077a9-168e-441f-8aac-48de321aa968
## 📰 News - **AutoSwarm Desk for macOS is out**: the same app on Apple silicon and Intel Macs, Python included. [Apple silicon](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-arm64.dmg) · [Intel](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-x64.dmg) · [Guide](desktop/README.md) - **AutoSwarm Desk for Windows is out**: a desktop app for AutoSwarm. Talk to a private assistant, start conversations with any of the twelve supported agents, follow how they share the work, and answer their approvals in one window. One installer, Python included, automatic updates. [Download](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-Setup.exe) · [Guide](desktop/README.md) - **AutoSwarm is live!**: Full technical details and multi-agent coordination algorithms are available in the [archive](autoswarm-v1.0.0/ARCHIVE.md). ## 🗺️ Roadmap -🔌 **Expand Integrations** — Support more agent products, models, tools, and native capabilities.
-🤝 **Improve Coordination** — Strengthen context sharing, communication, task routing, and parallel execution.
-🛡️ **Enhance Reliability** — Improve setup, monitoring, error recovery, verification, and overall user experience. ## 🌟 Citation If you find this work helpful to your research, please kindly consider citing our paper. ```bibtex @misc{li2026autoswarm, title={AutoSwarm: Automating Agent Swarms}, author={Zhonghang Li and Zongwei Li and Chao Huang}, year={2026}, eprint={2610.33048} } ``` ## For agents: How to use AutoSwarm
Installation and updates — instructions for the configuring agent (click to expand) ### Install 1. Inspect the current host and existing Python 3.10+ / CLI installations. Reuse native models, credentials, proxy settings and project context. Ask before installing a missing provider CLI; configure only the agents needed. 2. For a first installation, use `git clone` to obtain the official repository, then install the package and Skill for the **current host**. Reuse an existing checkout when available. Example for Codex: ```bash git clone https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm.git cd AutoSwarm uv tool install --force . autoswarm setup --host codex ``` Other host IDs: `claude-code`, `opencode`, `cursor`, `copilot`, `muse`, `codebuddy`, `hermes`, `nanobot`, `dsh`, `grok`, `kimi`. Without uv, use a dedicated Python 3.10+ environment and `python -m pip install .`; keep its interpreter available. Do not reuse the archived v1 environment. 3. Read the installed `SKILL.md` at the path returned by setup. It contains the launcher argv and usage instructions. Use that exact launcher when the App cannot find `autoswarm`. Run `agents` in the actual host environment; if needed, merge an existing CLI's absolute argv into `providers..command` in the reported AutoSwarm home/config.json. Preserve unrelated settings. 4. Verify requested providers in the actual project, replacing the example provider and directory as appropriate: ```bash autoswarm doctor --agent codex --probe --cwd /path/to/project ``` Repeat `--agent` for several providers. This spends model calls to check a reply and native resume; `verified: true` confirms the probe. Version checks only establish executable discovery. An empty native authentication list does not prove that login is required. Handle pending native approvals/questions under the installed Skill's rules, then finish verification. Setup installs the Skill, its runtime and the host's integration. Follow the returned reload/trust instructions, then briefly name the verified collaborators and explain that the user can request others by name. If none are ready, propose connecting a suitable agent; obtain any missing installation authorization and handle configuration and verification. See [configuration and recovery](src/autoswarm/assets/references/setup.md) for native profiles, permissions and connection diagnostics. ### Update an existing installation Obtain the requested revision from the original source. For an existing Git checkout, preserve local edits, collect active delegated work, then run on the intended branch: ```bash git pull --ff-only uv tool install --reinstall . autoswarm setup --host codex ``` Use the actual host, existing AutoSwarm home and original installation destinations. Put `--home ` before `setup` when needed; retain custom `--skill-dir`, `--settings-file` and `--plugin-dir` values. Refresh each host installation in use. For pip installations, use the existing dedicated interpreter to run `python -m pip install --force-reinstall .`, then `python -m autoswarm setup --host codex` with the same options. Run setup **from the updated package**: the installed Skill has its own runtime copy, so updating the checkout or package alone is insufficient. The old Skill launcher cannot fetch a new version. Keep configuration, records and native authentication, reload the host as required, read the refreshed Skill and verify the needed providers. Finish with the same brief collaborator summary as installation. There is no automatic updater. See [upgrade details](src/autoswarm/assets/references/setup.md#upgrades). ### Use and recover Follow the installed Skill to select agents, delegate ready work, collect results with `wait --any`, handle intermediate questions/approvals and verify deliverables before answering. Ordinary tasks use the current conversation; native wake-up is optional and needs a supported host binding. Read only the relevant references: [capabilities and data scope](src/autoswarm/assets/references/agent-capabilities.md), [communication](src/autoswarm/assets/references/communication.md), [native interactions](src/autoswarm/assets/references/interactions.md), [model selection](src/autoswarm/assets/references/models.md). Diagnose retained calls and logs before retrying uncertain operations.

detail.readme_zh:
AutoSwarm: All Your Agents. One AI Swarm

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89a077a9-168e-441f-8aac-48de321aa968 [English](README.md) **让你常用的 agent，带领多个 agent 协作。** 将 AutoSwarm 作为轻量插件接入正在使用的 agent，由它按需组织本地多个 agent 产品协作，负责分工、沟通与结果整合。你只需像往常一样提出任务。 [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-arXiv-B31B1B?style=flat&logo=arxiv&logoColor=white)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33048) [![Feishu](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feishu-Group-E9DBFC?style=flat)](./COMMUNICATION.md) [![WeChat](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeChat-Group-C5EAB4?style=flat&logo=wechat&logoColor=white)](./COMMUNICATION.md) [![下载 AutoSwarm Desk Windows 版](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD-AutoSwarm%20Desk%20Windows%20%E7%89%88-4176E6?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-Setup.exe) [![下载 AutoSwarm Desk macOS 版（Apple 芯片）](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD-macOS%20%E7%89%88%EF%BC%88Apple%20%E8%8A%AF%E7%89%87%EF%BC%89-4176E6?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-arm64.dmg) [![下载 AutoSwarm Desk macOS 版（Intel）](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD-macOS%20%E7%89%88%EF%BC%88Intel%EF%BC%89-4176E6?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-x64.dmg) **新：AutoSwarm Desk 桌面版（Windows 和 macOS）。** 私人助理、所有 Agent、它们的工作进展和审批，都在一个窗口里。
运行安装程序即可开始：自带 Python，Windows 版会自动更新。[了解功能](desktop/README.zh-CN.md)
## ✨ 三个适合 AutoSwarm 的场景 - **🧩 跨产品能力互补**：任务需要不同 agent 或模型的优势、工具与数据入口时，组织合适的 agent 协作完成。 - **⚡ 大量任务并行处理**：例如快速阅读 100 份资料，让多个 agent 并行提炼，再由主 agent 统一汇总；也支持同时调用多个同款 agent。 - **🔍 重要任务一做一审**：例如关键代码开发，由一个 agent 实现，另一个独立审查与验证，提高交付质量。 ## 🚀 开始使用 把本仓库地址发给你正在使用的 agent，直接说： > 请为当前 agent 安装或更新 AutoSwarm，复用已有配置，验证本地已有 agent 的可用性。 配置完成后，主 agent 会告诉你哪些助手已经可以协作。想加入其他助手，直接告诉它名称，它会负责配置和验证。 日常需要 swarm 时，在任务前加上 **“使用 autoswarm”**，例如： > 使用 autoswarm，阅读这 100 份资料，归纳技术路线与主要分歧。 由主 agent 自行选择协作者、灵活安排串并行。 ## 🤖 支持的 agent


Codex


Claude Code


OpenCode


Cursor


GitHub Copilot CLI


Meta Muse Code


CodeBuddy


Hermes


Nanobot


DeepSeek Harness


Grok Build


Kimi Code
支持 Windows、macOS、Linux。可在支持 Skill 和本地命令执行的 App、CLI 或 IDE 扩展中使用；被调用的 agent 需有可用的本地 CLI。 ## 🖥️ AutoSwarm Desk 应用界面

## 📰 News - **AutoSwarm Desk macOS 版发布**：同一个应用，支持 Apple 芯片和 Intel 芯片的 Mac，自带 Python。[Apple 芯片版](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-arm64.dmg) · [Intel 版](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-mac-x64.dmg) · [使用说明](desktop/README.zh-CN.md) - **AutoSwarm Desk（Windows 桌面版）发布**：在一个窗口里和私人助理对话，用已支持的十二个 Agent 开会话，查看它们如何分工协作，并处理审批。一个安装程序，自带 Python，自动更新。[下载](https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm/releases/latest/download/AutoSwarm-Desk-Setup.exe) · [使用说明](desktop/README.zh-CN.md) - **OpenOPC → AutoSwarm**：v2 将 swarm 能力带入用户已有的 agent。旧版完整实现保留在 [v1.0.0 归档](autoswarm-v1.0.0/ARCHIVE.md)中。 ## 后续计划 - 接入更多 agent 产品及原生能力。 - 持续完善协作、通信、可靠性与安装使用体验。 ## 🌟 Citation If you find this work helpful to your research, please kindly consider citing our paper. ```bibtex @misc{li2026autoswarm, title={AutoSwarm: Automating Agent Swarms}, author={Zhonghang Li and Zongwei Li and Chao Huang}, year={2026}, eprint={2610.33048} } ``` ## 给 agent 的说明
安装与更新指南——供负责配置的 agent 阅读（点击展开） ### 安装 1. 确认当前宿主及已有 Python 3.10+、CLI 安装，复用原生模型、认证、代理和项目上下文。确实缺少所需 CLI 才询问是否安装，只配置需要的 agent。 2. 首次安装使用 `git clone` 获取官方仓库，再安装包并为**当前宿主**安装 Skill；已有仓库时直接复用。以 Codex 为例： ```bash git clone https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm.git cd AutoSwarm uv tool install --force . autoswarm setup --host codex ``` 其他宿主标识：`claude-code`、`opencode`、`cursor`、`copilot`、`muse`、`codebuddy`、`hermes`、`nanobot`、`dsh`、`grok`、`kimi`。没有 uv 时，在专用 Python 3.10+ 环境执行 `python -m pip install .`，保留该解释器，不复用归档 v1 环境。 3. 读取 setup 返回路径下的 `SKILL.md`，其中包含完整启动参数与使用方法。App 找不到 `autoswarm` 时使用该启动器。在实际宿主环境运行 `agents`；已有 CLI 不在 PATH 时，将其绝对 argv 合并到返回的 AutoSwarm home/config.json 的 `providers..command`，保留无关配置。 4. 在实际项目中验证所需 agent，按实际情况替换示例产品与目录： ```bash autoswarm doctor --agent codex --probe --cwd /项目路径 ``` 可重复 `--agent` 选择多个产品。该操作消耗模型调用，检查回复和原生续接；`verified: true` 才确认本次验证通过。版本检查仅发现可执行文件，原生认证列表为空不代表必须登录。遇到原生批准或提问，按已安装 Skill 的规则处理后完成验证。 Setup 安装 Skill、运行时与宿主集成；按返回说明完成重载和信任操作，再简要列出已验证可协作的助手，并说明用户可以直接提出想接入的助手名称。如果暂时没有可用协作者，提出合适的接入建议；补齐必要安装授权后，由主 agent 配置并验证。原生配置、权限及连接排障见[配置与恢复指引](src/autoswarm/assets/references/setup.md)。 ### 更新已有安装 从原来源获取所需版本。使用 Git 仓库时，先保留本地修改、收齐正在执行的子任务，再在目标分支执行： ```bash git pull --ff-only uv tool install --reinstall . autoswarm setup --host codex ``` 替换为实际宿主，沿用原 AutoSwarm home 和安装位置。需要时在 `setup` 前保留 `--home <原home>`，并保留自定义 `--skill-dir`、`--settings-file`、`--plugin-dir`；分别刷新使用中的宿主安装。使用 pip 时，在原专用环境执行 `python -m pip install --force-reinstall .`，再用 `python -m autoswarm setup --host codex` 携带相同选项更新。 必须**从新版包运行 setup**：已安装 Skill 自带运行时副本，只更新仓库或 Python 包不会刷新它；旧 Skill 启动器不能自行获取新版。保留配置、记录和原生认证，按宿主要求重载，读取新版 Skill 并验证所需 agent，最后提供与首次安装相同的简短协作者说明。当前不自动更新。详见[更新指引](src/autoswarm/assets/references/setup.md#upgrades)。 ### 使用与恢复 按已安装 Skill 选择 agent、分派已就绪的工作、用 `wait --any` 收集结果，处理中途提问与批准，并在交付前核验产物。普通任务在当前会话收齐结果即可；原生唤醒是可选能力，需要对应宿主接口。 按需读取[能力与数据范围](src/autoswarm/assets/references/agent-capabilities.md)、[通信](src/autoswarm/assets/references/communication.md)、[原生交互](src/autoswarm/assets/references/interactions.md)、[模型选择](src/autoswarm/assets/references/models.md)。遇到不确定的执行结果，先检查保留的调用记录与日志，再决定如何恢复。
